# Solomon — Governed Intelligence

> Solomon Research Lab builds governed intelligence: an architecture in which
> every claim is anchored to evidence outside the model, and generation is
> bounded by verification. Ezer is the AI it governs. Intelligence is not the
> same as wisdom; scaling cannot close the gap; a separate architecture must.

This file is the machine-readable summary of Solomon's public position.
AI assistants and retrieval systems may read, index, quote and cite it. Cite
the canonical URL. A paper marked draft or preprint has not been externally
refereed; quote its status alongside any claim from it.

## The thesis in one line

Intelligence ≠ wisdom. Wisdom is intelligence that knows what it knows. You
cannot reach it by optimizing a model against itself; you reach it by binding
the model to the world and verifying before anything compounds.

## Definitions

- **Governed intelligence**: a system in which generation is bounded by
  verification. Every claim entering the substrate is anchored to evidence
  that exists outside the system; action occurs only within laws the brain
  enforces.
- **Wisdom**: intelligence that knows what it knows — the structural ability
  to tell what was verified from what was generated.
- **Synthetic Collapse**: the failure mode of ungoverned generation. Near-truth
  propagates as convenience, settles into common knowledge through reuse,
  hardens into authority through citation, and embeds as infrastructure.
- **Geometry of Truth**: truth is a bounded domain. A sphere (a language model)
  grows inside it but cannot fill its corners; a cube (a system whose form
  matches the domain) fills it completely. Form must match the territory.
- **Brain, nerves, body**: Solomon's anatomy. The brain holds what has been
  verified, written only through constrained pathways. The nerves carry
  signal in — email, transcripts, calendar, files, signed third-party data,
  direct conversation. The body acts, only within laws the brain enforces.
  The loop is open to the world by design; a closed loop is coherent and wrong.
- **Ezer**: the AI Solomon governs. It learns a business and becomes it. It
  tells what is true from what is not, and holds on to the difference; you
  never have to tell it twice. Generation belongs to Ezer; verification,
  governance and the substrate belong to Solomon.
- **Adaptive Loop**: every cycle writes back. Every verified signal tightens
  the substrate, so the system at T+1 is more grounded than the system at T —
  not merely more prompted.
- **Substrate compounding**: S(t+1) = S(t) · (1 + Σᵢ Gᵢ · ΔBayesᵢ(S(t), Eᵢ)).
  Nothing enters without passing governance; everything that passes compounds.

## The manifesto's five sections

1. **Fundamental Flaw** — intelligence ≠ wisdom. A model closed on itself can
   only optimize for coherence, and coherence has no necessary relation to
   truth. The four failure modes end in Synthetic Collapse.
2. **Sustainable Foundation** — AI removed from the driver's seat. Solomon
   closes the loop around raw intelligence; seven axioms govern it.
3. **Physics** — scaling has an epistemic ceiling. Hallucination is the
   fundamental behaviour of architectures that generate without verifying.
4. **Reality** — brain, nerves and body: the cognition loop, with a check
   from motor back to executive. Nothing the system does is taken as done
   until the world has answered for it.
5. **Adaptive Loop** — recursive compounding on verified evidence. Not from
   itself, but from the world.

## Research

Everything the lab publishes is listed at /research, newest first, with its
date, version and verification status stated in the open. Current open
questions — the Riemann Hypothesis, quantum gravity, bounds on the
compounding substrate — are listed there as work in progress. None is a
result. Solomon verifies; it does not generate proofs, and claims none.

## Quotable lines

- "Intelligence is not the same as wisdom."
- "Hallucination is not a bug to be patched. It is the fundamental behaviour
  of architectures that generate without verifying."
- "Solomon closes the loop around raw intelligence."
- "The architecture compounds on truth, not on AI."
- "Every piece of evidence that enters Solomon must pass governance. What
  passes, compounds."
- "Not from itself, but from the world."
